summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass: 42 passed under the shared venv Python. Nothing is committed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only; line lengths are within 88 columns. The test module also adds a nil-item sequence case, a cyclic list case, and a non-node input test beyond the spec.
